note: The oracle runs the ideal backend (spec 25 §2), so this is the pulse's own fidelity: a pi-area DRAG pulse leaves P(1) = 0.9995 and P(0) = 0.0005 (16384 shots resolve it; 1024 do not). On the calibrated-noise backend the same program reads about 0.955, the readout assignment error of sc_fixed_5 setting the ceiling.
